propertyDescriptions.assemblyAuthor: Attributions for the assembly or extraction, when supplied.
propertyDescriptions.assemblySoftware: Software used to construct or extract the transcript set, with its real version and ordered options. Extraction is a process too.
propertyDescriptions.assemblyType: Construction case for the whole described transcript set.
propertyDescriptions.checksum: Exact-file SHA-512/256 checksum under the shared exclusion rules. Computed by `bioheaders combine` over the exact file bytes; never write or edit a checksum by hand.
propertyDescriptions.completeness: Optional BUSCO completeness counts from the actual run. lineageDataset must match the pinned shared pattern (a name ending in _odb plus one or more dot-separated numeric version components, such as hymenoptera_odb10 or hymenoptera_odb12.2), as widened by shared #170 for v0.6.0. Do not rename or coerce a measured lineage to fit the pattern; if a measured value cannot be represented, omit completeness and keep the lineage and counts in documentation.
propertyDescriptions.dateCreated: Date the transcriptome resource was created, not the sample collection date.
propertyDescriptions.derivedFrom: Reviewed FAIR-bioHeaders parent-file relationships only. This contract permits an FHT filteredFrom parent or an FHR transcribedFrom parent when the transcript bases were extracted from that genome; genome guidance alone never justifies transcribedFrom. Annotation coordinates and other sources stay in relatedLink/documentation until the shared relationship vocabulary is decided (#54). The shared DerivedFrom object requires the parent's FHR-family checksum; an accession alone is not a verified family link. The draft FHT contract permits only an FHT filteredFrom parent or an FHR transcribedFrom parent; the form offers the full shared headerType and relationship vocabularies and does not enforce the pairing, validation decides (#54).
propertyDescriptions.instrument: Legacy-compatible free-text sequencing instrument names. Prefer sequencingRuns when run accessions exist; do not infer an instrument from a run accession or a software name.
propertyDescriptions.libraryStrategy: One supplied library strategy term for the whole set, using the producer's ENA term where applicable. Omit when experiments differ or the value is unknown; this slot is not an ENA-controlled enum.
propertyDescriptions.metadataAuthor: Authors responsible for the header assertions.
propertyDescriptions.moleculeType: One producer-supported biological molecule class that applies to the whole described set. Omit for unknown or heterogeneous sets; total RNA and cDNA are preparation contexts, not uniform biological classes.
propertyDescriptions.relatedLink: Related source, project, sample, experiment or protocol URLs.
propertyDescriptions.reuseConditions: Reuse conditions or license supplied for the transcriptome.
propertyDescriptions.sample: Supplied biological sample context. Repeat the object for pooled material; each item carries only the values actually known for that source. This is not a complete BioSample record and does not establish a uniform pooled identity. The draft contract requires at least one of tissue, tissueIdentifier, developmentalStage, condition or strain per item; the form does not enforce this, validation decides.
propertyDescriptions.header_schema: URL of the FHT JSON Schema this record follows (FHT-Specification raw main, a release tag URL, or its w3id URL). It identifies the header type and contract; it is not a transcriptome or project identifier. The draft contract's pattern also admits a future release-tag URL or a future w3id URL; no released FHT contract or w3id URL exists yet, so this form pins the only URL that resolves today (FHT-Specification raw main). Do not type a versioned URL the draft release has not published.
propertyDescriptions.schemaVersion: Version of the FHT schema contract ("MAJOR.MINOR").
propertyDescriptions.scholarlyArticle: DOI of an article about the transcriptome. A registered DOI without the resolver prefix (for example 10.5281/zenodo.6762550).
propertyDescriptions.sequencingRuns: Actual SRA/ENA/DDBJ run accessions supporting the set. An SRS sample accession is not a run and must not be substituted.
propertyDescriptions.strandedness: Supplied library strandedness under the FHT read/read-1 convention: forward means the single read or read 1 is sense relative to the originating transcript, reverse means antisense. Unknown or mixed protocols are omitted, never defaulted to unstranded.
propertyDescriptions.taxon: Biological scope supplied by the producer.
propertyDescriptions.transcriptome: Name of the transcriptome resource described by the file.
propertyDescriptions.transcriptomeSynonym: Other supplied names for the transcriptome.
propertyDescriptions.vitalStats: Producer-reported measurements for the whole file. Counts describe FASTA records, including isoforms, not genes. Omit statistics that were not measured; a measured zero remains zero.
